name: Francisco Assis - Après le § 57 - Am 45
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 57a. Calls on the Member States to support the ICJ, and in particular the initiative of the Republic of South Africa to prosecute Israel for war crimes and genocide in Gaza; demands that Israel immediately comply with the legally binding orders issued by the ICJ, whereby it ordered Israel to prevent genocide against Palestinians and let necessary aid enter Gaza;
